title: fix: run community monitor with Opus 5.5
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pins monitor cycles to claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort and documents the required Claude Code 2.1.280 or newer.
- Preserves the 300,000-token compaction setting, current prompt, 30-minute cadence, probe backoff, and state.
- Updates this existing PR from main; supersedes the proposed Fable 5.1 switch.
- Verified on EC2: upgraded the existing npm installation from 2.1.267 to 2.1.280 and received a successful tool-disabled response attributed to claude-opus-5-5 with the existing login.
- Validation: all 18 monitor tests, shell syntax, and diff checks pass. Biome does not process these shell/Markdown files.

gist.headline: The monitor got better ears
gist.blurb: The community monitor now does its rounds with Claude Opus 5.5. Same 30-minute garden walk, sturdier set of ears.
gist.summary: Pinned the operations/community-monitor loop to claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort and documented the Claude Code 2.1.280+ requirement while preserving its 300,000-token compaction, 30-minute cadence, backoff, prompts, and state.
gist.impact: Community monitoring continues with the existing schedule and stateful behavior, now using a verified Claude Opus 5.5 setup on Claude Code 2.1.280 or newer.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-monitoring station represents the internal community monitor: Polli, wearing tiny operator headphones, checks a CRT terminal labeled "OPUS 5.5" beside a clock showing a steady 30-minute cycle. Code-plants, a compacted stack of notes, and a small status light convey preserved state and reliable monitoring.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a calm reliable garden-shed atmosphere.
